links.outcome: Guideline-item coverage and clarity of GPT-5 checklists versus guideline-derived traditional checklists
links.effect: AI coverage 97.0% ± 2.1% vs 89.0% ± 3.2% for traditional; clarity 4.8 ± 0.2 vs 4.2 ± 0.3 (p = 0.021).
links.quote: AI-generated checklists demonstrated higher mean guideline-item coverage than traditional checklists (97.0% ± 2.1% vs. 89.0% ± 3.2%) and higher clarity scores (4.8 ± 0.2 vs. 4.2 ± 0.3; p = 0.021).

unlisted_practices: Implementability review and structured local curation (core vs conditional elements) of AI-generated checklists to prevent bundle inflation

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance (guideline coverage and clarity) of checklists generated by GPT-5 compared to traditional checklists, assessed by blinded clinical raters offline.
